structuredContent.body:
The terminal campaign and C1 results needed reproducible resource comparisons and exact independent replay evidence. This mechanical archival stage retains 49 original curve reports, both resource views, all six strict-best HCSN full-D replays, and the original training-trace coverage audit.

The resource analysis independently reconciles 2,969 confusion matrices; a separate reviewer confirms the budget selections and cost rules. All six full-D replays reproduce the original metrics, but all six original HCSN fits remain budget-censored. Every retained original training trace has update_index=0, so no post-update trajectory coverage is credited.

The snapshot also preserves the ignored-log publication defect and exact-byte recovery, committed-tree verification, the hosted science artifact for run 42890048946, prior blocking-CI failures, complete scoped costs, and draft-asset readback receipts. Failed or incomplete attempts remain visible. No acceptance threshold, training result or scientific-admission status is changed.

Validation: 228 manifest members, eight ZIPs and 34 document links pass the existing integrity checker; the committed-tree check verifies 1,022 distinct regular blobs across the five evidence manifests and explicit entrypoint dependencies. Independent index review reports no blocking finding. Both local and remote whole trees are da62f605dfa9771c439d0f91edf3deff5aed7818. This is evidence reproducibility, not sufficiently trained benefit, whole-training numerical qualification, or repository-wide CI success.

Stacked on #5841. Draft only; no main merge or release publication.
